name: SSHI_Bridge_Zener
rationale: The reference FBR failed S4, S5, and S6 due to insufficient voltage (power extraction) and S3 due to overvoltage. I am implementing a Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) topology. By adding an inductor and a switch across the piezo that closes at the voltage extrema, the charge on the piezo capacitor Cp is inverted each half-cycle, significantly increasing the energy extracted. A full-bridge rectifier directs this energy to the storage capacitor, and a DZ33 Zener diode clamps the output voltage to 3.3V to satisfy the vmax <= 3.6V constraint for S3.
